history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V4 decision and adds the complete owned WebAssembly memory surface as one family plus explicit scalar-oracle and shared-memory capability subpanels. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Moves wasm_memory from deferred to implemented. Cross-engine rows use the existing non-shared v128 memory export, a separately scored scalar-memory oracle uses the equivalent same-module export, and a zig-js-only shared-memory atomic panel requires the system-JSC rejection probe before reporting N/A.

implemented_families_append.surface: owned fixed-width v128 load/store arithmetic over non-shared linear memory
implemented_families_append.shared_ruling: One non-shared Wasm instance is not invoked concurrently; the wasm_memory_shared_atomic capability panel owns shared-memory execution.
implemented_families_append.anti_specialization: Base traverses jobs in ascending order; the variant uses a distinct wrapper, identifiers, loop condition, accumulator, and descending order over identical v128 memory inputs. The export reinitializes its memory before every call, so call order cannot alter the checksum.

additional_panels_append.boundary: The same module and memory algorithm use scalar i32 loads/stores; source evaluation, module lifecycle, and timing boundaries match the cross-engine family rows.

JavaScriptCore.result: N/A: system JSC public JSGlobalContext rejects the shared-memory/atomic module

additional_panels_append.boundary: One worker invokes the shared-memory atomic export on the owner thread; 2/4/8-worker rows time zig-js shared-realm Thread construction, concurrent disjoint atomic updates on one instance, joins, and exact final validation.
